data.title: Check our privacy policy.
data.description: Our Privacy Policy ensures your data is safe during asset, diamond, and boosting orders. We only collect the game username and password needed to complete your service. Your credentials are fully encrypted and never shared. Crucially, we never store your data permanently—all login details are completely wiped from our systems the moment your order is finished. For total safety, please change your password once your service is complete.

seo.description: A compelling subtitle for your post.

data.content:
Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our platform. We are committed to protecting your privacy and securing your game account data, credentials, and digital purchases.

Services Covered

Our platform provides a variety of gaming services tailored to enhance your experience. These services include, but are not limited to:

  • Game Assets: The distribution, trade, or management of virtual items.
  • Diamonds & Currencies: The processing and delivery of in-game premium currencies.
  • Account Boosting & Leveling: Services where designated players log into or play on your game account to increase your rank, status, stats, or assets.

Information We Collect

Account Credentials

To perform boosting services or transfer assets, we collect the minimum necessary details to manage your access:

  • Your chosen platform username/email and game password.
  • Temporary verification codes or backup codes needed to bypass two-factor authentication during the service.

Transaction Data

To successfully fulfill orders for diamonds or virtual assets, we track order details, purchase history, and delivery status numbers.

How We Secure Your Data

Password Security

Your game account credentials and game password are strongly encrypted before reaching our secure infrastructure. We never view or store plain-text passwords in an unencrypted state.

Operational Safety

For account boosting services, our designated players access your account using rigid security parameters to prevent unauthorized modifications outside the scope of your order.

Data Retention (We Don't Store Data Permanently)

We believe in strict data minimization. We do not store your personal login credentials or account access permanently.

Purging Protocols

  • Your game account password and login details are completely purged from our active operational systems as soon as your asset delivery or boosting service is marked complete.
  • Temporary session logs are automatically overwritten on a regular cycle.

Data Sharing and Third Parties

We do not sell, trade, rent, or share your game passwords, account access details, or order history with third-party advertisers, data brokers, or external corporations. Your data stays strictly within the secure infrastructure required to complete your requested service.

Your Responsibilities

While we take extensive measures to secure your data during service fulfillment, security remains a shared responsibility. We strongly recommend that you change your game account password immediately after your boosting service or asset delivery is complete. Do not share your active temporary credentials with anyone outside our verified platform.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted directly on our platform with an updated revision date.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, your account data, or want to request the immediate deletion of your transaction logs, please contact our support team. You can always visit our Help Desk for immediate assistance.

products.title: Uid Topup [Indonesia]
products.desc: Short description (shown on the card and the top of the product page)
products.rules:
✅ এই প্রোডাক্টটি শুধুমাত্র Bangladesh সার্ভারে ID Code দিয়ে টপ আপ হবে।
⏰অর্ডার করার সাথে সাথে ডেলিভারি হবে । তবে নির্ধারিত সময়ের মধ্যে না পেলে, দয়া করে আমাদের WhatsApp সাপোর্ট নম্বারে মেসেজ দিন।
🛑 Player ID Code ভুল দিয়ে Diamond না পেলে Topupshop কর্তৃপক্ষ দায়ী নয় ।
✔️Order কমপ্লিট হওয়ার পরেও আইডিতে ডাইমন্ড না গেলে চেক করার জন্য ID Pass দিতে হবে।
✔️অর্ডার Cancel হলে কি কারণে তা Cancel হয়েছে তা অর্ডার হিস্টোরিতে দেওয়া থাকে অনুগ্রহ পুর্বক দেখে পুনরায় সঠিক তথ্য দিয়ে অর্ডার করবেন।

data.title: Check our privacy policy.
data.description: Our Privacy Policy ensures your data is safe during asset, diamond, and boosting orders. We only collect the game username and password needed to complete your service. Your credentials are fully encrypted and never shared. Crucially, we never store your data permanently—all login details are completely wiped from our systems the moment your order is finished. For total safety, please change your password once your service is complete.
